plan.planning_summary: Refining route_03 after iteration_18 compilation failure (initial thickness outside bounds). Three routes proposed: (1) Si/Al2O3 23-layer with corrected thickness bounds and quarter-wave outer layer initialization, (2) Ge/SiO2 23-layer alternative material pair for higher index contrast, (3) Si/Al2O3 23-layer with asymmetric cavity defect positioning. All routes embed the converged 22-layer thickness distribution from iteration_15 as inner core, add one outer layer, and increase thickness upper bound by 15% (400-1265 nm) to prevent boundary clipping.

routes.title: Si/Al2O3 23-Layer Dual-Cavity Filter with Corrected Thickness Bounds
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Adding one outer quarter-wave layer to the converged 22-layer Si/Al2O3 dual-cavity design while expanding thickness bounds by 15% will maintain or improve target score above 0.85 while eliminating the initialization-out-of-bounds compilation error.
routes.design_principle: Embed the iteration_15 best candidate thicknesses (22 layers) as inner core, add one outer Si layer initialized to quarter-wave at 3.3 um central wavelength (~550 nm), expand bounds from 400-1100 nm to 400-1265 nm to accommodate gradient steps without hard-boundary clipping.

routes.execution_request_english: Design a 23-layer planar multilayer filter on CaF2 substrate at normal incidence. Layer sequence: Air | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | CaF2. Initialize inner 22 layers with thicknesses from iteration_15 best candidate [502, 538, 621, 599, 496, 583, 612, 497, 535, 545, 906, 627, 613, 510, 545, 606, 629, 1017, 461, 450, 576, 865] nm, initialize outer layer (layer 1) to 550 nm quarter-wave at 3.3 um. Thickness optimization bounds: 400-1265 nm for all layers. Optimize for high transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands, low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 2500-3100 nm, 3250-3350 nm, 4200-4300 nm, 4450-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands; Low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 24; No metal layers; Conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials only.
routes.revision_reason: Fix iteration_18 compilation error (initial thickness outside bounds) by expanding bounds 15% and adding outer layer per feedback directive. Embed iteration_15 converged 22-layer thicknesses as inner core.

routes.title: Ge/SiO2 23-Layer Dual-Cavity Filter with Higher Index Contrast
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Ge/SiO2 material pair provides higher refractive index contrast than Si/Al2O3, enabling sharper band edges and better out-of-band blocking within the same 23-layer count, potentially achieving best_target_score above 0.88.
routes.design_principle: Replace Si/Al2O3 with Ge/SiO2 for higher index contrast (Ge n~4.0 vs Si n~3.5 in mid-IR; SiO2 n~1.45 vs Al2O3 n~1.65). Maintain dual-cavity defect topology with 23 layers, quarter-wave initialization at band centers.

routes.title: Si/Al2O3 23-Layer Asymmetric Cavity Dual-Band Filter
routes.scientific_hypothesis: Asymmetric defect cavity positioning (different cavity depths for methane vs CO2 bands) will improve independent band control compared to symmetric dual-cavity design, potentially reducing spectral coupling between the two passbands.
routes.design_principle: Modify the dual-cavity topology from iteration_15 by repositioning defect layers asymmetrically: methane band cavity (3.3 um) positioned closer to air interface, CO2 band cavity (4.25 um) positioned closer to substrate. Maintain 23 total layers with Si/Al2O3.

routes.execution_request_english: Design a 23-layer planar multilayer filter on CaF2 substrate at normal incidence with asymmetric dual-cavity topology. Layer sequence: Air | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si (defect_methane, 1.5x quarter-wave at 3.3 um) | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si (defect_CO2, 1.5x quarter-wave at 4.25 um) | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si | Al2O3 | Si (outer) | CaF2. Initialize non-defect layers to quarter-wave at respective band centers, defect layers to 1.5x quarter-wave. Thickness optimization bounds: 400-1265 nm for all layers. Optimize for high transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands with independent weighting, low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with band-specific objective weighting. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 2500-3100 nm, 3250-3350 nm, 4200-4300 nm, 4450-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 3.25-3.35 um and 4.20-4.30 um bands; Low transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 2.50-3.10 um and 4.45-5.00 um bands. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count <= 24; No metal layers; Conventional depositable infrared inorganic dielectric materials only.
routes.revision_reason: Test asymmetric cavity topology as alternative to symmetric dual-cavity from iteration_15. May improve independent band control and reduce spectral coupling.

research_influence: Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:227248144 supports quarter-wave stack principle with alternating high/low index dielectrics for sharp spectral profiles. Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:139773493 validates Ge-based bandpass filters for methane sensing at 3.3 um, motivating Ge/SiO2 alternative route. Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:17683472 motivates thickness constraints and layer count limits for manufacturability. Evidence s2-chunk:CorpusId:235711786 supports TMM-based dual-objective optimization for competing transmission/blocking targets.
